newsitem.title: USA: Royal Caribbean sets record booking week.
newsitem.headline: Royal Caribbean sets record booking week.

text.p: Royal Caribbean International said the week of January 4 through 10 was its best booking week in history, with 102,430 passengers booked.
The figure exceeded the previous weekly booking record of 87,056, set in January 1996, the company said.
The company said 17,449 passengers were booked through CruiseMatch 2000, its real-time, direct-access computer system for travel agents.

Royal Caribbean operates 11 modern ships with a capacity of 18,774 passengers. In 1997 and 1998 the company will introduce the last three of its six Vision-class ships, adding new capacity of 5,950 passengers. In 1999 it will introduce the first of its 3,100-passenger Eagle-class ships.
